newsitem.title: USA: ConEd sees NY Indian Pt 2 nuke online Fri..
newsitem.headline: ConEd sees NY Indian Pt 2 nuke online Fri..

text.p: Consolidated Edison Co of New York (ConEd) said Wednesday its 975 megawatt (MW) Indian Point 2 nuclear power plant just north of New York City will begin putting electricity on the grid by Friday.
"We expect to be on the grid in the next 24 to 48 hours," a ConEd spokeswoman said.
Indian Point 2 has been out of service since May 1 for refueling.
The ConEd spokeswoman said the unit was now ready to begin producing electricity.
"The reactor is critical. We're doing final testing," she said.
Separately, the neighboring 965 MW Indian Point unit 3, operated by the New York Power Authority, is tentatively set to restart early August after being shut May 14 for refueling and maintenance.
